requirement: New Jersey has a minimum burial depth requirement in state waters of 5 ft (1.5m).
related_domains: cable installation; subsea infrastructure; engineering standards

requirement: The developer will need to make a measured assessment should the transmission cable(s) cross shipping lanes or other areas of high shipping activity.
scope: Offshore wind farm transmission cables crossing shipping lanes or areas of high shipping activity.
source: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement Guidance
related_domains: navigational safety; risk assessment; cable protection

requirement: An overriding consideration will be the requirements of the System Quality and Security of Supply (SQSS) criteria where any amount of risk, however small, could be unacceptable.
scope: Offshore wind farm transmission cables, particularly concerning spacing and routing in areas of high shipping activity and vessel anchorages.
source: System Quality and Security of Supply (SQSS) criteria
related_domains: system integrity; security of supply; risk management; cable routing; navigational safety; electrical grid stability

requirement: It is important that all parties reach agreement on mutually acceptable routing and spacing, with acceptable risk levels to the cables, but at the same time allowing the development of other commercial enterprises, a right enshrined in international law.
scope: Offshore transmission cables for wind farms
source: UNCLOS (United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea)
related_domains: spatial planning; resource management; legal compliance; navigational safety

requirement: Due consideration must be given to installation methodologies of the array cables into the OSP and to maximize cable spacing between array cables to afford best options for any maintenance or repair operations that may be warranted.
scope: Array cables, OSP (Offshore Substation Platform), Installation phase, Maintenance/Repair operations
source: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement - Offshore Wind Submarine Cable Spacing Guidance
related_domains: cable installation; maintenance operations; safety; spatial planning

requirement: The spacing of export cables from the OSP to the edge of the wind farm through the wind farm area will be governed by the same principles of maximizing separation and ensuring optimal cable security as for export cables outside the wind farm area.
scope: Export cables, OSP (Offshore Substation Platform), Wind farm area
source: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement - Offshore Wind Submarine Cable Spacing Guidance
related_domains: cable installation; cable security; spatial planning

requirement: BOEM currently requires a 200 ft right of way corridor for offshore wind farm cables.
related_domains: cable routing; spatial planning; infrastructure development

requirement: The federal regulation CFR 585 requires a Facilities Design Report, Construction and Operations Plan, Fabrication and Installation Report, Site Assessment Plan and General Activities Plan.
